description: Pangolin Knight default look, PIXEL-SAMPLED from design/reference/pangolin_knight-character-sheet.webp (intake.json swatch chips 70,52,47 / 131,87,64 / 177,114,81 / 203,146,102 / 243,208,170 / 72,59,57 + medians of the drawn surfaces, outline pixels excluded). Cream face / chest / belly with a tan fur edge, brown layered scales in three tones + a dark outline band, a segmented tail, dark grey-brown gauntlets with lighter armour bands, dark claws, a pink nose, a black eye with a white glint. No glow (brief).
